# deed_service_account (Resource)

A Deed service account: a non-human user for automation (Terraform, CI) that has no password, SSO identity or session and authenticates only with API tokens (`deed_service_account_token`). Its installation role and project memberships (`deed_project_member` with its `id` as `user_id`) bound every token. Requires an installation `admin` (or owner) token and Deed 0.2.0 or newer. Destroying it deletes its tokens and memberships.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "deed_service_account" "terraform" {
  name              = "terraform"
  description       = "tf-infra"
  installation_role = "admin" # admin, auditor, or omit for project memberships only
}

# A read-only account for dashboards: no installation role, viewer in one project.
resource "deed_service_account" "dashboards" {
  name = "dashboards"
}

resource "deed_project_member" "dashboards" {
  project = deed_project.homelab.name
  user_id = deed_service_account.dashboards.id
  role    = "viewer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name: 1–63 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the service account is for.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name. Defaults to `name`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Disabling (`false`) revokes every token of the account. Default `true`.
- `installation_role` (String) Installation role: `admin` or `auditor`. Omit for none (the account then sees only the projects it is a member of). A service account cannot be an owner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User ID of the service account (`usr_…`); use it as `user_id` in `deed_project_member`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import deed_service_account.terraform terraform # name or user ID (usr_…)
```
